fullvendor.card: Plateforme principale ya gestion commerciale na distribution.
fullvendor.lead: Centre ya opération commerciale na yo : ba commandes, ba prix, stock na ba clients na esika moko.
fullvendor.about: FullVendor e remplacer ba feuilles de calcul mpe ba systèmes ya distributeur oyo ekangami te. Uta awa ba commandes ebimaka, ba consulter inventaire, ba soigner portefeuille ya ba clients mpe ba numéros ya mokolo batalaka. Ecosystème oyo etikali ezo connecter na base oyo.

points: Bandá na bakiliya, biloko mpe ntalo : bango nde molakisi oyo moto nyonso asalelaka.
Connecter commande na stock avant ya kobakisa ba applications mosusu.
Ezali komeka motángo moko ya pɛtɛɛ: mitindo oyo ekokisami kozanga ete básala lisusu formulaire.

Tango ozali ko synchroniser, commande ekoti déjà na entrepôt.

Confirmer eloko moko na moko tango ozali kokabwana. Nsɛlɛlɛ yango ekati na nzela ya koleka.
Dispatch ezo mettre à jour stock oyo moteki amoni.

Sales na finance esengeli kotala client moko.
Lapolo oyo eumelaka mokolo na mokolo ezali na motuya mingi koleka kokangama na retare.

legal.privacy_title: Politiki ya kobatela makambo ya moto ye moko
legal.privacy_intro: Politiki oyo ezali kolimbola oyo tosalaka na ba données oyo otikaka na ba formulaire na site oyo.

privacy.title: Ba données nini to ramasser
privacy.text: Soki osengi démonstration to okomeli biso, tobombaka kombo, entreprise, email, numéro ya téléphone soki olakisi yango, mboka, taille ya équipe, produit oyo osepeli na yango pe message. Tokomaka mpe mokolo, monoko ya lokasa mpe adresi IP, mpo na kopekisa botindiki ya mabe.

privacy.title: Tosalelaka yango mpo na nini?
privacy.text: Tosalelaka ba données oyo kaka pona ko répondre na yo, ko coordonner démonstration pe ko préparer proposition commerciale. Totɛkaka yango te to topesaka yango te na liste ya bato mosusu.

privacy.title: Babombaka yango wapi mpe na boumeli ya ntango boni?
privacy.text: Ba demandes ebombamaka na serveur ya site oyo. Tobombaka yango mpo na ntango oyo esengeli mpo na kosalela yo mpe bolandi ya mombongo, mpe tolongolaka yango ntango osɛngi biso to ntango ezali lisusu na mposa na yango te.

privacy.title: Makoki na yo
privacy.text: Okoki kosenga accès, correction to supprimer ya ba données na yo na formulaire ya contact, kolakisa yango na message. Soki société ebimisi email na site oyo, okoki pe kokoma kuna.

legal.terms_intro: Ba conditions oyo etali bosaleli site oyo ya botindiki FullVendor.

terms.title: Ba informations ya mombongo
terms.text: Ba textes, ndakisa ba chiffres ya tableau de bord na ba déscriptions ekotisaka plateforme. Bakoki kobongisa yango ntango biloko ebongwanaka mpe ezali te offrande oyo ekangami.

terms.title: Démo ezali contrat te
terms.text: Kotinda formulaire yango ebimisaka te mokumba ya kosomba to kobomba motuya. Kontra nionso eyokani na ndenge ekeseni, na mokanda, na bonene na yango mpe na ba conditions na yango.

terms.title: Makambo oyo ezali na site
terms.text: Elembo ya mombongo ya FullVendor, bankombo ya biloko mpe makambo oyo ezali na nkasa oyo ezali ya bankolo na yango. Bakoki kosala kopi na yango te mpo na kolakisa biloko mosusu.

terms.title: Kosalela oyo endimami
terms.text: Kosalela ba formulaire te mpo na kotinda ba informations ya lokuta, ba spam to ba contenus oyo eyokani te na mibeko. Tokoki koboya kotalela masengi oyo ekokani te na lisolo ya mombongo ya solosolo.
